raw_summary: Fed held rates at 3.50%-3.75% at Apr 29 meeting (Powell's likely final as Chair) with unusual 8-4 dissent. Market prices zero 2026 cuts, one 25bp cut in Dec 2027. Easing bias since late 2025 but inflation elevated partly due to energy prices.
